prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one polished Portuguese infographic for the BRLN club's proposed DIY Bitcoin signer. Wide landscape 16:9, high resolution, crisp editorial technical illustration, dark navy background, warm white text, restrained orange for Bitcoin/device and teal for private networking. Generous spacing and large legible typography. This is an architectural proposal, not a finished product advertisement.
Title exact: "BRLN · Assinador Bitcoin"
Subtitle exact: "Proposta: Bowser + LILYGO T-Display + LightningOS"
Small badge: "PROTÓTIPO EM DESENVOLVIMENTO"
Main diagram three clear columns:
LEFT: illustration of a tiny original LILYGO T-Display ESP32 development board, small rectangular screen, two physical buttons, visible PCB, no camera and no SD slot. Label "1 · ASSINADOR". Text "T-Display original · 1,14″ · 2 botões"; "Firmware Bowser em C/C++"; "Meta: gerar, recuperar e assinar na placa". Screen reads "Conferir e assinar".
CENTER: ordinary desktop monitor and USB cable, not a dedicated offline laptop. Label "2 · COMPUTADOR DO MEMBRO". Text "Navegador com Web Serial"; "Prepara a transação"; "Recebe a assinatura". Left-center bidirectional arrow labeled "USB · PSBT e assinatura".
RIGHT: outlined server zone labeled "3 · NODE LIGHTNINGOS". Inside stacked software boxes "App BRLN · backend Go", "Adaptador Electrum", "Electrs → Bitcoin Core", with connected flow. Center-right bidirectional arrow labeled "HTTPS via Tailscale". Within this node zone, separate small management rail "Loja LOS → broker de privilégios" linked by dashed management arrow ONLY to app, with caption "Instalação e ciclo de vida". Broker never signs, never holds seed, not in transaction data path.
BELOW LEFT: separate small metal backup plate with numbered blank lines (never actual mnemonic words), arrow from signer labeled "Anotação manual", label "BACKUP FÍSICO"; text "Palavras BIP39 + configuração"; "Recuperação independente".
Bottom strip: "PRIMEIRO PILOTO" followed by three compact stages "1. Validar a placa" "2. Recuperar com dois botões" "3. Integrar ao LOS".
Footer exact: "USB conectado • Sem câmera • Seed fora do app: requisito a implementar e testar"
Constraints: all text in Brazilian Portuguese, spell every label correctly. Diagram has no link from backup to internet, no Wi-Fi antenna on signer, no cloud, no real addresses or seeds, no promises of perfect security, no fake certifications. Visually show USB is bidirectional and the internet-facing computer separate from small signer. Avoid dense text, decorative padlocks everywhere, gradients that harm readability.
